securityTipsSubtitle: Beera mwegendereza ng'okkiriza okusaba okw'obubaka okuva eri abantu b'otamanyi. Weegendereze:
securityTipFakeNamesDescription: Dash Chat terikutuukirira kukusaba koodi yo ey'okwewandiisa oba PIN yo. Weegendereze okusaba okuva eri abeefuula abantu abalala. Amannya galondebwa bannannyini akawunti era tegakakasiddwa.
securityTipCryptoScamsTitle: Obufere bwa ssente za yintaneeti oba bwa ssente
securityTipCryptoScamsDescription: Omuntu gw'otamanyi bw'akuweereza obubaka obukwata ku ssente za yintaneeti (nga Bitcoin) oba ku mukisa gw'okufuna ssente, weegendereze—kirabika obwo bubaka obutayagalwa.
securityTipVagueMessagesDescription: Abasindika obubaka obutayagalwa batera okutandika n'obubaka obwangu nga “Hi” okukusikiriza. Bw'obaddamu, bayinza okwongera okukuyingiza mu mboozi.
securityTipLinksDescription: Weegendereze obubaka bw'abantu b'otamanyi obulimu linki ez'emikutu gya yintaneeti. Toggulangawo linki okuva eri abantu b'otesiga.
securityTipFakeBusinessesDescription: Weegendereze bizineesi oba ebitongole bya gavumenti ebikutuukirira. Obubaka obukwata ku bitongole by'emisolo, ku batuusa ebintu n'ebirala buyinza okuba obubaka obutayagalwa.
